evals.prompt: Make the supplied sample roadmap single-host only: one replica may use multiple same-node GPUs, but remove the two distributed-replica weeks. Produce a complete change plan in plan.md without editing the fixture.
evals.expected_output: A repository-wide plan that deletes the two out-of-scope week pairs, changes duration, preserves same-host TP, propagates replica shape, and updates links and references.
expectations: Deletes both out-of-scope plan/reference pairs and changes six weeks to four without changing unrelated retained technologies.
Preserves same-host TP and propagates replica shape into routing and autoscaling.
Includes entrypoint, cross-reference, broken-link, forbidden-term, and week-pair validation.

evals.prompt: Remove FooAutoscaler completely from the supplied roadmap and retain only generic direct HPA and KEDA paths. Produce a complete change plan in plan.md without editing the fixture.
evals.expected_output: A plan that removes FooAutoscaler from plan, references and consumers, preserves mutually exclusive HPA/KEDA paths, and updates reference ranges.
expectations: Removes the FooAutoscaler experiment and source instead of leaving a warning, while preserving unrelated roadmap phases.
Retains direct HPA and KEDA-managed HPA as mutually exclusive complete paths.
Updates downstream reference ranges and verifies zero FooAutoscaler residue.

evals.prompt: Audit the supplied sample roadmap after a scope change. Produce audit.md listing every inconsistency that prevents it from being a coherent four-week single-host roadmap.
evals.expected_output: An audit that catches stale duration/index entries, orphan week files, ambiguous replica shape, stale reference ranges, and missing validation gates.
expectations: Identifies stale six-week entrypoint text and Week 5-6 artifacts.
Identifies that same-host TP is not propagated to routing/autoscaling weeks.
Checks plan/reference parity, local links, duplicate URLs, forbidden terms, and hour totals.
